HazardDescription: Drug interaction warning fails to display due to a system fault
PotentialConsequence: Doctor prescribes a drug that is dangerous to the patient
MitigationMeasure: Fallback: mandatory manual double-check + mandatory warning logging

PotentialConsequence: Patient waits excessively, loss of trust, may delay urgent care
MitigationMeasure: Database unique(doctor, slot) constraint + application-layer validation

HazardDescription: Medical record data breach via cyberattack
PotentialConsequence: Privacy violation, legal consequences, reputational damage
MitigationMeasure: AES-256 encryption, TLS, RBAC, intrusion monitoring

HazardDescription: Reminder sent at the wrong time due to timezone bug
PotentialConsequence: Patient arrives late/early, disrupts doctor's schedule
MitigationMeasure: Standardize storage in UTC, multi-timezone testing
